message.basicchestsearch.cloth_missing: Please install 'Cloth Config' to change the settings for this mod.
key.category.basicchestsearch.title: Basic Chest Search
option.basicchestsearch.searchMode.toolt:
SORT: Hides non-matching items
DARKEN: Dims non-matching items
DISABLED: Disables the search
option.basicchestsearch.keepSearch.toolt: If enabled, the search text is preserved when closing and reopening a container.
option.basicchestsearch.autoFocus.toolti: Automatically focuses the search bar when opening a container.
Detaches the search bar from the inventory window.
option.basicchestsearch.focusSearch.tool:
Key or combination, such as Ctrl+F, that focuses the search bar.
Click the button, then press the keys. Unbound by default.
option.basicchestsearch.clearSearch.tool:
Key or combination that clears the search text.
Click the button, then press the keys. Unbound by default.
